title: Analysis code for: Carbon Emissions from Cell-Culture Plastics Across Europe (COST Action CA21108, NETSKINMODELS)
description:
Python pipeline supporting the article Carbon Emissions from Cell-Culture Plastics Across Europe. It covers (1) automated retrieval of polymer-specific emission factors from the life-cycle-assessment literature, (2) processing of six months of procurement records from 53 dermatology research laboratories in 22 European countries into per-laboratory plastic mass and CO2e, and (3) the Mann-Whitney comparison of plastic consumption and carbon footprint between laboratories in COST Inclusiveness Target Countries (ITC) and non-ITC laboratories.

The results released here are country-level aggregates and the article figures. The laboratory-level survey records are not redistributed: the survey collected participants' names, affiliations and free-text comments, which are personal data under the GDPR and were removed before any release, and a per-laboratory row would remain linkable to an institution in countries represented by a single laboratory. Country and Inclusiveness Target Country status are the only geographic granularity the analysis uses, and they are published in full.

This work is based upon COST Action CA21108 NETSKINMODELS, supported by COST (European Cooperation in Science and Technology).
